summary:
Edge now runs Douglas–Peucker on the outline's integer lattice (L3's option (a)), in src/shared/Physics/Edge.luau. Nothing is committed and Studio was not touched. scripts/verify is NOT green: the machine was never quiet. A game (Enshrouded) and other programs not mine kept it 40–73 % busy from 09:30 to 13:42, and four waits of 55 minutes timed out. Under about 51 % load, verify passed tools, sourcemaps, T-META-07 and both luau-lsp passes (0 errors), then 731 tests passed and 1 failed: T-PERF-01, F2's longest stretch 0.468 ms against 0.35 (it is at most 0.24 quiet). Result: TESTS FAILED, exit 1. Every functional case passes.

What changed in Edge:
- simplify compares squared distances times the span's squared length, as integers: cross², |ap|²·|ab|² or |bp|²·|ab|² against tol²·|ab|². Ties go to the first maximum by index, and DEGENERATE_SPAN2 is gone.
- A run's points sit on the doubled lattice. A segment's length is its lattice length × h/2, and kept points are converted back to blueprint XY.
- The header states the magnitudes: under 2^52 for any design within Canonical's bounds.

Bit-compare against m3-r1b-base: M2's physics, cutIndex and the raster never move.
- 136 Parity fixtures: 33 identical, 91 moved only in their last bits (every F, C, X and A fixture is in these two groups), 12 really moved, no tier changed. Fixer B's figures are confirmed to the digit (P1 2 → 4 chains, P2 14 → 15, P4 5 → 6, worst valid 3 and 7, worst valid 9's Sharpening 0.0549 → 0.0543). New beyond his list: P2's specks, P5's chain order and worst valid 10.
- Parity's 200 generated designs: 3 really move, no d changes.
- 33,389 plausible designs: 28 really move, 12 d values change by at most 0.0012, no tier changes.
- Every real move is one of four exact ties the float rule settled by rounding:
  - a point exactly 1 cell off its segment;
  - two points tied for the farthest;
  - a chain exactly EDGE_MIN_CHAIN cells long;
  - equal-length chains, now ordered by their first point.
- Y shifts now keep every edge to the bit: 1,793 Gen copies, 410 fixture copies, and the critic's #89 and #131.

Tests and goldens:
- T-EDG-01 item 6 asserts exactness on all of these. The critic's two designs run in the fast suite.
- The difficulty goldens and parity digests are re-blessed. 55 entries move only in EdgeLength's last bits. 7 move in their chains (P1, P2, P4 and P1's and P2's specks). No g, d or tier moves. No other golden changed.

Finding: |ΔG| = 0 under Y shifts does not hold everywhere, and the cause is Thinness, not the edge. A probe that lies exactly on another part's face is decided by rounding, and a shift re-rounds it:
- F1's and F5's tip at +0.125: 0.0007;
- X02 at +0.125: 0.0031, past TOL_G_INVARIANT;
- 12 of the 500 Prop designs: up to 0.0016.

So T-DIF-07 (a) asserts EdgeLength and G to the bit except where Thinness moved, and lists F1 and F5. The SPEC now names this channel under O11.

Also found: E-S2.13's X-mirror figure was stale. Since fixer A's round, D moves up to 0.0621 (was 0.0081); the lattice changes nothing there.
